title: Continue-or-adjust review at follow-up (F6)

patient_mappings.node_id: BaselineCurrency (applicability input, not a network node)
allowed_source_paths: encounters.baseline_encounter_id (follow-up linkage to the chosen signed baseline)
encounters.draft_data.history_reconciliation (must be confirmed, not pending)
encounters.baseline_changed (must be false; a newer signed record without reconciliation makes the baseline outdated)

encounters.draft_data.continue_review.baseline_linkage (PROPOSED, not collected: linked_current vs outdated_unreconciled vs unknown_incomplete with recorded baseline encounter id and reconciliation date)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: linked_current iff the follow-up records the chosen signed baseline encounter id, history and medications are reconciled and confirmed, and no newer signed record is pending reconciliation. outdated_unreconciled iff any of those fails. unknown_incomplete iff linkage not recorded. No maximum recency interval is imposed in v0.1; the interval between baseline and current dates is recorded and displayed for physician interpretation.
patient_mappings.time_window: baseline encounter timestamp (frozen signed snapshot) through current follow-up encounter timestamp; reconciliation recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.missing_policy: outdated_unreconciled, unknown_incomplete, missing, or conflicting linkage yields needs_clarification and stops later questions (never not_applicable, never a posterior). Saving corrected and reconciled input creates a new run.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.improvement_status (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: improved_stable vs residual_burden with recorded symptom domains, validated scale name and version, and baseline reference)
content/assessments/panss.json#panss-v1 (supporting scale only, never a gate or state determinant)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: improved_stable iff the clinician records the course as improved and stable on the current treatment with supporting domains, scale name and version, and baseline reference. residual_burden iff the clinician records significant residual symptoms or functional difficulties despite some response. Never inferred from a PANSS total, band, or percent change; no percent-change value is computed and no cutoff is applied.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter judgment with baseline reference; supporting scale in its documented previous-7-days window with recorded instrument name and version
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing, not_assessed, or conflicting judgment yields needs_clarification (required input blocks).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.course_context (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: chronic_recurrent vs non_chronic with recorded relapse history)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: chronic_recurrent iff the clinician documents chronic symptoms or repeated prior relapses. non_chronic iff the clinician records neither. else unknown_incomplete. This proposed composite requires operational criteria; the state is recorded as assessed, never derived from a count cutoff.
patient_mappings.time_window: longitudinal history at the current encounter
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when unknown_incomplete
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves the assessed state as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input). Course information is rendered as a discussion item; in v0.1 it conditions no child output.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.effects.tardive_dyskinesia.status
encounters.draft_data.effects.tardive_dyskinesia.severity
encounters.draft_data.effects.akathisia.status
encounters.draft_data.effects.akathisia.severity
encounters.draft_data.effects.parkinsonism.status
encounters.draft_data.effects.parkinsonism.severity
encounters.draft_data.effects.acute_dystonia.status
encounters.draft_data.effects.acute_dystonia.severity
encounters.draft_data.continue_review.significant_side_effects (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: present vs absent_assessed)

encounters.draft_data.continue_review.metabolic_concern (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: Yes vs No for clinically significant weight gain, diabetes, or metabolic syndrome without numeric thresholds)
content/history/history-effects-v0.1-draft.json#adverse_effect_contract.effects (present/absent/not_assessed; present requires severity)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: none_assessed iff all four FR-21 effects are recorded absent with null severities AND significant side effects are recorded absent AND metabolic concern is recorded No. metabolic_concern iff metabolic Yes without any other concern. other_concern iff any effect is recorded present with severity or significant side effects are recorded present, without metabolic Yes. combined_concern iff metabolic Yes with any other concern. Effect-specific detail (F1-F4) is assessed in its own follow-up question; only the aggregated constituents reach this node and no posterior is carried between questions.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician ratings recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.missing_policy: any constituent not_assessed, missing, or conflicting, or any effect present without severity, yields needs_clarification (required input blocks). Unknown is never mapped to none_assessed.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.preference_barrier (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: absent vs present with recorded same-agent continuation preference detail: ContinueSame vs DiscussChange vs NoExpressedPreference vs not_elicited)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: absent iff the clinician records no reluctance or barrier to ongoing medication. present iff the clinician records reluctance or a barrier, with the same-agent preference detail preserved in the field and rendered in the template. else unknown_incomplete. NoExpressedPreference is an assessed response preserved in the field detail, not mapped to missing.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when unknown_incomplete
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves the assessed state as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.adherence_context (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: absent_assessed vs present with recorded evidence)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff the clinician assesses difficulty maintaining prescribed treatment during the exposure interval. absent_assessed iff the clinician assesses no such difficulty. Dispensing records alone never establish ingestion. else unknown_incomplete.
patient_mappings.time_window: current treatment interval at the current encounter
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when unknown_incomplete
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves the assessed state as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.exposure_change_context (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: absent_assessed vs present with recorded interacting medicines, smoking, body-mass, renal or hepatic, or absorption change)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff the clinician identifies a relevant pharmacokinetic or exposure change. absent_assessed iff the clinician assesses none. Direction is never inferred. else unknown_incomplete.
patient_mappings.time_window: current treatment interval at the current encounter
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when unknown_incomplete
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves the assessed state as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.practical_availability (PROPOSED structured field, not collected: available vs access_barrier with recorded access or formulary detail and LAI formulation-mismatch note)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: available iff the same active antipsychotic remains accessible. access_barrier iff an access or formulary barrier is recorded. LAI formulation mismatch is recorded in the field detail and rendered as template context only; LAI product choice is outside this question. else unknown_incomplete.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when unknown_incomplete
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves the assessed state as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.continue_review.urgent_assessment (PROPOSED structured field, not collected)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff the clinician records suspected NMS, cardiac toxicity, severe constipation, infection or neutropenia, seizure, or acute psychiatric danger requiring a separate assessment pathway. absent_assessed iff the clinician assesses no urgent concern. Absent does not certify safety.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing urgent assessment yields needs_clarification (required input blocks). Present fires the deterministic urgent flag without waiting for any model output.

applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind and baseline linkage only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: registration encounters yield not_applicable with reason (F6 is follow-up only; never a posterior). Outdated, unreconciled, unknown, missing, or conflicting baseline linkage yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected and reconciled input creates a new run. Missing required input (improvement judgment, any tolerability constituent including present-without-severity, urgent concern) yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (course, preference, adherence, exposure change, practical availability) leaves that node as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

evidence_mappings.evidence: mapped improved_stable/residual_burden state as hard evidence when assessed; missing blocks before inference
mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state; missing field maps to unknown_incomplete with disclosure
mapped aggregate state as hard evidence when all constituents assessed; any missing constituent blocks before inference
mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state

mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state
mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state
mapped absent_assessed/present state as hard evidence when assessed; missing blocks before inference; present also fires the deterministic flag

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete where declared) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).
reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branch rendered as review prompt only; maximum posterior is not a recommendation rule; deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs shown first and never waits for LLM; adherence, tolerability-exposure, and urgent posteriors always rendered alongside the continuation branch; unknown_disclosure and context_note always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/outdated/conflict; not_applicable branch on registration encounters

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. The 12-node F6 prompt and response exceed the smaller F1-F5 ceilings, so higher proposed maxima are recorded here. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.
